title: Windshield Frame Land — Corrosion Blend and Re-Protection at the Lower Forward Corner
abstract: Blend and re-protection of light corrosion on the windshield frame land at the lower forward corner, found when the sealant is stripped, with the limits that decide between local repair and a frame repair approval request.

sections.purpose: This repair covers light corrosion on the windshield frame land at the lower forward corner, found during the inspection that precedes the drained bracket installation or during any windshield removal.
sections.damage_assessment: Strip the sealant and clean the frame land, then examine at ten times magnification and measure the pit depth with the corrosion depth gauge. The repair admits pitting up to 0.30 millimetres deep over an area not exceeding 900 square millimetres, with no pit closer than 8 millimetres to a fastener hole. Exfoliation, any pit at a fastener hole, or corrosion extending under the bracket footprint beyond the inspected area, are outside this repair. Photograph the as-found condition against the scale card before blending, because the acceptance is judged on the blended result and the before image is the only record of what was removed.
sections.repair_procedure: Blend the corroded area with the abrasive pad set, keeping the blend faired into the surrounding land with a radius of at least 20 millimetres. Measure the residual land thickness at four positions and confirm it is inside the limit on the repair drawing. Clean and dry the area. Apply the chemical conversion coating, then the primer, respecting the drying time for each. Where the drained corner bracket is to be fitted, confirm the blend does not intrude into the drain land before the bracket is installed. Install the bracket and the retaining fasteners, then apply the sealant bead to the standard applicable to the bracket fitted.
sections.inspection_requirements: Do a detailed visual inspection of the blended land before the sealant is applied and record the residual thickness values. Do a detailed visual inspection at every subsequent windshield removal. If the same corner is found corroded a second time, this repair may not be repeated; the frame repair approval route applies and the drainage arrangement must be re-examined.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: Pitting up to 0.30 mm deep over not more than 900 mm², no pit closer than 8 mm to a fastener hole, no exfoliation.

type_data.fastener_pattern: Existing frame pattern retained, new fasteners at every position disturbed
type_data.fatigue_life_note: No life limit when the residual land thickness stays inside the limit. The repair may be applied once per corner; a second finding at the same corner requires a repair approval request.
